en.text: The most important Shinto event takes place in the New Year, when millions of people visit shrines to pray for happiness and a healthy year.

original: 正月の伝統的な行事が嫌いな人もある。

en.text: Some people dislike the traditional New Year's ritual.

original: 正月の伝統的な行事が嫌いな人もいる。

en.text: Some people dislike the traditional New Year's ritual.

original: 間違っているということを馬鹿に納得させる最も良い方法は、その愚かな行為を遂行させる事である。

en.text: The best way to convince a fool that he is wrong is to let him have his way.

original: 僕らはみんな行くべきだ。

en.text: All of us ought to go.
All of us should go.

original: 友達は私の愚かな行動を叱ってくれた。

en.text: My friends scolded me for my stupid behavior.

original: 軽率な行動はとるな。

en.text: Don't act rashly.
